headline: Globale Tessile files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Globale Tessile Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. This is a routine compliance filing fulfilling statutory post-AGM disclosure requirements. Retail investors in Globale Tessile need to review these results only if specific shareholder resolutions were contested. Such procedural disclosures have no direct impact on the broader market or share price.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on share value.
